📖 How to use

  1. Paste or type your text into the box.
  2. Stats update automatically as you type.
  3. Check words, characters, sentences and paragraphs.
  4. Use Clear to reset or Copy to copy your text.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are words counted?

Any sequence of non-whitespace characters counts as one word, so hyphenated words count as a single word.

How is reading time estimated?

Reading time is calculated at an average speed of 200 words per minute, rounded to the nearest display unit.

Is my text uploaded anywhere?

No. All counting happens in your browser and your text never leaves your device.
